biocs.name: Multiple Rare LOLBIN Process Executions
biocs.description: Detection of multiple rare LOLBINs executed by a single user within a short time window
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ['mshta.exe', 'wmic.exe', 'rundll32.exe']
| comp count() as cnt by actor_user_name, action_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by
| filter count > 1

abiocs.name: Abnormal LOLBIN Usage Pattern
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from normal user process execution using rare LOLBINs
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ['mshta.exe', 'wmic.exe', 'rundll32.exe']
| filter actor_user_name != 'SYSTEM'
| comp count() as cnt by actor_user_name, action_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by
| filter count > 1
